knowledge.title: PROPERTY_CORE (hub)
knowledge.content: Property hub: one row per source property/building, unioned from EDP, LIGHTBOX, MTA and DIQ ephemeral models. Grain: one row per SOURCE_UNIQUE_ID per REF_GDP_SOURCE_SYSTEM_SKEY. LIGHTBOX SOURCE_UNIQUE_ID = BUILDING_LID; EDP = EDP_PROPERTY_BUILDING_SKEY::string. Hard deletes: active target rows of a source whose id is in that source's *_property_entity_ids delta but absent from source are re-emitted with GDP_IS_ACTIVE = FALSE.

knowledge.title: PROPERTY_ADDRESS (spoke)
knowledge.content: Property address spoke: standardised address, raw SOURCE_* address, and geocode attributes. Grain: one row per SOURCE_UNIQUE_ID per REF_GDP_SOURCE_SYSTEM_SKEY. Spoke of PROPERTY_CORE through PROPERTY_CORE_SKEY. Every address must carry REF_ADDRESS_TYPE_SKEY, STREET_NAME, STATE and COUNTRY. ESRI post-hooks geocode and may overwrite standardised address/lat/long. STATE_PROVINCE is emitted by the model and included in the hkey but was not present in PROD_GDP_SILVER_DB.PROPERTY.PROPERTY_ADDRESS at time of capture (verify DDL).

knowledge.title: Per-Target Join Graph
knowledge.content:
## Per-Target Join Graph (third pattern)

When targets within a single STTM share most bronze tables but require distinct join shapes, generate per-target extraction CTEs (NOT a shared CTE).

**Detection signals** (any one):
- STTM `Join` cell contains target-name section markers (e.g., `------ PROPERTY_ADDRESS`).
- Different targets reference disjoint sets of bronze tables.
- A subset of targets requires a filter not applicable to others.

**Code pattern**: each ephemeral model has its own `sp_<target>` extraction CTE with its own bronze JOIN graph; the contract documents Pattern A / Pattern B / etc. per target.

**Reference example**: EDP property domain — PROPERTY_CORE/USAGE/ADDRESS use Pattern A (`dim_property_building` + `dim_property_usage` + `country` + `fact_aar`).

knowledge.content: A source must map at least: `source_unique_id`; `property_name`; `property_address`; `property_usage_desc`

knowledge.title: Merged per-source union pipeline
knowledge.content: Each unified Silver PROPERTY model unions per-source ephemeral models, each guarded by m_is_source_active('<src>'). Steps: unioned -> source_data -> filtered (left join {{ this }} on SOURCE_UNIQUE_ID + REF_GDP_SOURCE_SYSTEM_SKEY; keep rows where NVL(hkey) differs or GDP_IS_ACTIVE differs) -> hard_deletes (active target rows for ids in the source's *_property_entity_ids delta that no longer exist in source, emitted with GDP_IS_ACTIVE = FALSE) -> final select with coalesce(existing_skey, SEQ_<TABLE>_SKEY.NEXTVAL). Post-hook m_insert_history writes <TABLE>_HIST. To onboard a new source: add <src>_property_<entity>.sql + <src>_property_entity_ids.sql, add a union branch and an orphan branch to each unified model.

knowledge.title: PROPERTY hash-key columns
knowledge.content: Hash keys use generate_sha2_hash_key via macros property_core_hkey/property_usage_hkey/property_address_hkey (lightbox_utils.sql). Every source must produce all hkey input columns (NULL where unavailable) so hashes are comparable.
